name: cosmos-stockdata-tools
description: Fetch and validate daily China A-share and index data with a bundled portable SuperMind runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Fetch and validate daily China stock-market data.
interface.longDescription: Bundles a portable SuperMind notebook, JupyterHub driver, and fail-closed workbook validator for Beijing-time A-share and index extraction, with pre-mutation dependency checks, durable output protection, recovery-gated failed-run state, and separate index-catalog and quote-coverage validation. It supports each user's own SuperMind account without external project paths or bundled credentials. No fallback is currently bundled; after a confirmed SuperMind coverage gap and user approval, baostock is preferred and akshare is reserved for requirements baostock cannot cover or explicit user direction.
defaultPrompt: Fetch and validate the latest completed Beijing trading day's full A-share dataset.
Download an existing SuperMind workbook for a specified trading date.
Check whether SuperMind can provide a new stock-data field.
